messages:
Ravi (Design): Quick idea: instead of a full modal for every canary tweak, what if we show an inline confirm-popover next to the percent control for small deltas, and only escalate to modal for big jumps or 100%? Keeps flow fast but prevents fat-fingers.

Lena (PM): I like that. Support has a couple of cases where users accidentally set 100% when they meant 10%. Rules: popover for <=20% delta, modal for >30% or direct to 100%. Need copy and accessibility rules.

Carlos (Frontend): Popover is nice — easier to implement. Important: don't steal focus for popover. Use aria-live for SRs so they get announcement, but for modal we do alertdialog + focus trap. Also the popover should be reachable by keyboard (Enter opens it).

Nia (A11y): Agree. For the popover: aria-live="polite" with a hidden SR-only summary. For modal: role="alertdialog", aria-labelledby + aria-describedby. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for any micro-animations.

Ravi (Design): Draft popover copy:
- Line1: "Confirm: change routing from 12% to 20% for v4?"
- Line2 (muted): "Undo available for 2 minutes"
- Buttons: [Confirm] [Cancel] (Confirm is primary)
Keep it compact.

Lena (PM): Tweak line1 to "Confirm change: 12% → 20% to v4?" and line2 to "Undo within 2 min". Ops also asked to surface current error/latency metrics briefly if available.

Carlos (Frontend): We can show a tiny inline sparkline and error rate badge inside the popover header. Tooltip for the metrics should be keyboard-focusable.

Nia (A11y): Tooltips must have a keyboard target and aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip. For visual users, add a low-contrast icon with title. For SRs, include the metric text in the aria-live message.

Ravi (Design): Motion: subtle slide+fade for popover (150ms). For timeline highlight when change is confirmed: 1s background fade on the affected lane, but disabled for reduced-motion.

Carlos (Frontend): CSS sketch:
```
.popover { transform: translateY(6px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .15s ease, opacity .15s ease; }
.popover.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .popover { transition: none; }}
```
I'll prototype accessibility hooks in the PR.

Lena (PM): For the modal (big change) copy: "Reroute X% to v4. This is a large change — consider scheduling or ramping. I understand the impact." With a required checkbox for >25% and primary button "Confirm and route".

Ravi (Design): Good. Also add short SR copy when action completes: "Routing updated: v4 at 20%. Undo available for 2 minutes." Keep it under 120 chars.

deploy-bot: Rollout: v4 -> 20% started (job id 11009).

Nia (A11y): I'll draft a checklist: popover -> aria-live polite + SR text; tooltip -> keyboard target + aria-describedby; modal -> alertdialog + focus trap, checkbox accessible label. Will post in thread.

Carlos (Frontend): I'll implement popover and metric badge, will add hooks for SR messages. PR soon.

Lena (PM): I'll update the product rules doc with thresholds and ops logging requirements. Thanks team :thumbsup:
